# OpenPGP.js browser distribution

`openpgp.min.mjs` is copied without modification from **openpgp 6.3.2**,
`node_modules/openpgp/dist/openpgp.min.mjs`. The lockfile pins package integrity.
The regression suite compares these bytes to the installed distribution.

License: LGPL-3.0, included in `OpenPGP-LICENSE`.
Corresponding source and build instructions: https://github.com/openpgpjs/openpgpjs/tree/v6.3.2
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/openpgp/v/6.3.2

Replace the package, distribution, license and verified tests together when updating.
No CDN or remote script is loaded by the application.
